transitions.name: Cut
transitions.summary: Straight from one shot to the next.
transitions.whenToUse: Almost always, especially inside a conversation. Let a voice start a moment early or carry over to keep the talk flowing.
transitions.sound: Changes with the picture (new cuts blend it over 0.1 s so it never clicks).

transitions.name: Dissolve
transitions.summary: The next shot slowly fades in over this one.
transitions.whenToUse: Time passing, a change of place, a gentle mood. Not between two people talking.
transitions.sound: Blends from one to the other at an even loudness.

transitions.name: Fade through black
transitions.summary: This shot fades to black, then the next fades up.
transitions.whenToUse: Endings, chapter breaks, a long jump in time.
transitions.sound: Fades out with the picture, then the next shot's sound fades in.

transitions.name: Fade through white
transitions.summary: This shot fades to white, then the next fades up.
transitions.whenToUse: A memory, a dream, a bright upbeat break. Use sparingly.
transitions.sound: Fades out with the picture, then the next shot's sound fades in.

transitions.name: Fade in
transitions.summary: The shot fades in from the background color (black unless the cut sets another).
transitions.whenToUse: The very first shot, or coming back after a pause.

transitions.name: Wipe
transitions.summary: An edge sweeps across the frame and reveals the next shot.
transitions.whenToUse: Playful or retro pieces, or a clear "meanwhile". Flashy: only when the project's transition style asks for it.
transitions.sound: Blends from one to the other over the wipe.

transitions.name: Slide
transitions.summary: The next shot slides in over this one.
transitions.whenToUse: Lists, steps, before/after. Flashy: only when the project's transition style asks for it.
transitions.sound: Blends from one to the other over the slide.

transitions.name: Push
transitions.summary: The next shot pushes this one out of the frame.
transitions.whenToUse: Energetic sequences, moving on to the next thing. Flashy: only when the project's transition style asks for it.
transitions.sound: Blends from one to the other over the push.

transitions.name: Zoom
transitions.summary: The picture zooms in and through into the next shot.
transitions.whenToUse: Punchy reveals, hype moments. Flashy: only when the project's transition style asks for it.
transitions.sound: Blends from one to the other over the zoom.

transitions.name: Whip
transitions.summary: A fast blurred swish, as if the camera whipped over to the next shot.
transitions.whenToUse: Fast energetic pieces, on a beat. Flashy: only when the project's transition style asks for it.
transitions.sound: Blends quickly from one to the other.

sound.name: With the picture
sound.summary: The sound changes at the same moment as the picture.
sound.example: Sam's voice starts when we see him.

sound.name: Voice starts early
sound.summary: The next shot's sound starts a moment before we see it (an editor would call this a J-cut). The shot before it gets quieter as it starts.
sound.example: Sam's voice starts 0.4 s before we see him.

sound.name: Voice carries over
sound.summary: This shot's sound keeps going for a moment over the next shot (an editor would call this an L-cut).
sound.example: Maya's voice carries 0.3 s over the next shot.

sound.name: Into the nearest pause
sound.summary: MetaRush moves the sound change into the nearest pause, using the transcript, so no word is cut off.
sound.example: The voices change in the pause after "…and that's how it started."

easings.name: Even speed
easings.summary: The same speed all the way through.

directions.name: Left
directions.summary: The next shot comes in from the right and moves left.

directions.name: Right
directions.summary: The next shot comes in from the left and moves right.

directions.name: Up
directions.summary: The next shot comes in from the bottom and moves up.

directions.name: Down
directions.summary: The next shot comes in from the top and moves down.

edges.name: Fade in at the start
edges.summary: The video fades in from black.
edges.how: the first clip's transitionIn {"type":"fade","duration":1} (or "dip-to-white" to fade in from white)

edges.name: Fade out at the end
edges.summary: The video fades out to black, picture and sound together.
edges.how: the last clip's "fadeOut": 1.5 (or setTransition with edge "end")

styles.name: Natural
styles.summary: Straight cuts, with voices that start early or carry over; a dissolve only when time passes; fade through black for endings.
styles.splitEdits: Often: voices carry over a reaction, the next speaker starts a moment early (0.3–0.8 s).

styles.name: Snappy
styles.summary: Tight straight cuts, with voices that start a moment early; the odd push or whip on a beat.
styles.splitEdits: Short ones (0.2–0.4 s), mostly the next speaker starting early.

styles.name: Smooth
styles.summary: Dissolves between scenes, longer fades, gentle sound blends.
styles.splitEdits: Longer ones (0.5–1 s) with longer blends (0.2–0.3 s).

styles.name: Playful
styles.summary: Slides, pushes, zooms, wipes and whips are welcome, still with clean cuts inside a conversation.
